name: v4.24.0
body:
For an installation guide, refer to the [README](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/blob/main/README.md).

## 📦 Update MCP Bundle Installation
**For Claude Desktop users:**

→ [Download linkedin-mcp-server-v4.24.0.mcpb](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/releases/download/v4.24.0/linkedin-mcp-server-v4.24.0.mcpb)

Then click the downloaded file to install in Claude Desktop.

> **Note:** MCP Bundles do not auto-update. You need to download and install the latest `.mcpb` file for each new release.

## 🐳 Update Docker Installation
**For users with Docker-based MCP client configurations:**
```bash
docker pull stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server:latest
```
The `latest` tag will always point to the most recent release.
To pull this specific version, run:
```bash
docker pull stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server:4.24.0
```


<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v4.24.0 -->

## What's Changed
### 🚀 Features
* feat: add opt-in Codex plugin by @jjoanna2-debug in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/863
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* fix(scraping): Preserve feed cleanup on cancellation by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/887
* fix(ci): Check attribution on bot-triggered runs by @stickerdaniel in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/898
* fix(references): Add contexts for jobs, saved_jobs and feed by @ConnorMoss02 in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/892
* fix(tools): accept stringified network in search_people by @illogicalproject in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/747
* fix(bootstrap): allow configurable installer temp directory (#878) by @ffroliva in https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/879
